description: Validates database migration runners for command allowlisting, migration directory existence, credential hygiene, explicit deploy ordering, and rollback/timeout contract enforcement

rules.description: db-migration-runner-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare command, migrationDir, and orderingPolicy
The directory declared in migrationDir must exist in the repository. A missing directory causes the migration runner to fail at startup before executing any migrations

The migration command must include an allowlisted migration tool. Arbitrary shell commands in a highly privileged database context create code execution risks. Only well-understood migration frameworks are allowed

Database connection strings and passwords must be supplied via environment variable references — no hardcoded credential values are permitted in the spec. Hardcoded credentials are committed to source control and exposed in CI logs

orderingPolicy must be one of pre-deploy/deploy/post-deploy. Running migrations in the wrong phase causes schema/code mismatches: pre-deploy is safest for additive changes, post-deploy for cleanup, deploy for non-breaking in-place changes
db-migration-runner-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers
Every migration runner must declare a rollbackCommand (to undo a failed migration automatically) and a timeoutSeconds (to prevent a stuck migration from blocking the deployment pipeline indefinitely)
